colours.name: surface.pane
colours.use: Panes that are not active; the tab track

colours.name: surface.raised
colours.use: The active pane, the selected tab, buttons

colours.name: fill.hover
colours.use: A tab or row under the pointer

colours.name: fill.quiet
colours.use: Key caps, a button under the pointer

colours.name: ramp.1 violet
colours.use: Accent and focus ring; default session colour

colours.name: ramp.5 amber
colours.use: Waiting and the bell: amber arc

colours.name: ramp.6 green
colours.use: Finished: closed green ring; session colour

colours.name: session.blue
colours.use: Session colour; the one colour not on the ramp

colours.name: track
colours.use: The grey track behind a progress ring or bar (status.ring, the pane header bar). Not an alias of outline: the dark values coincide but the light values differ (#cfcbc5 vs outline's #bfbbb5)

opacities.name: faint
opacities.use: The unfilled background of a working/progress ring, drawn over its own colour

ramps.name: ramp
ramps.use: Decoration: full strength in the app mark, half strength (see ramp.caption_opacity) across the active pane's caption. Never behind text

ramps.name: ramp.extended
ramps.use: Progress only: the sections of a running status ring, and the fill of a pane header's bar. Nowhere else

tint.name: tint
tint.use: The open session's track fill in the top bar

radius.track.use: The tab track and session chips

radius.inner.use: Anything inside a radius.track or radius.surface container

radius.round.use: Colour chips and progress bars, fully round (Tokens.dc.html's radii card draws this as a fourth swatch, 999px - CSS's way of writing fully round, not a design-named value in px; this entry's name is the orchestrator's choice and the engineer may change it)

row.gap.use: The Row layout primitive's gap, by what it holds (Layout.dc.html)

track.layout.use: The Track layout primitive: a rounded container holding items of one height (Layout.dc.html). radius_inner = radius_outer - inset, a function, not a separate literal

split.layout.use: The Split layout primitive's gap, same values as pane.gap (Layout.dc.html)

overlay.layout.use: The Overlay layout primitive, same width/top as palette (Layout.dc.html). Its max-height-as-percent-of-window and its 40px-clear-below-720px rule are both doc-10's not-yet-confirmed bullet ("growing to at most 60% of the window's height" is the same bullet as the 40px-clear rule, not a separate settled value) - carried forward as a question, not exported

motion.name: motion.status-fade
motion.use: A change of status fades in on both the ring and the bar, so it reads as a change and not a jump

motion.name: motion.cursor-fade.shaded-dissolve
motion.use: The cursor's six pieces dissolve away and reform while the window has focus, each piece passing briefly through a flat medium shade on its way out and back; stops whole the instant focus is lost. Design's exploration option 2B, 'Scattered dissolve, through medium shade' (Atoms, Cursor atom card 07; Foundations page section 12, 'Rules: accessibility') - distinct from option 1A, 'Scattered dissolve' (same piece order, no shade step), not exported here
